blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Prove from the first principle that: \({}^{n}P_{r} = n \cdot {}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh hisaab ka nahi, proof (saboot) ka sawal hai.
Humein dikhana hai ke dono sides har \(1 \le r \le n\) ke liye barabar hain.
Plan: "first principle" ka matlab hai bunyadi formula \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\) se shuru karna. Right side ko simplify karte karte left side bana denge, aur aakhir mein ginti (counting) wali wajah bhi samjhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n\) alag alag cheezein, \(1 \le r \le n\).
Saabit karna hai: \({}^{n}P_{r} = n \cdot {}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\).
Tareeqa: Bunyadi formula \({}^{n}P_{r} = \frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\). Proof mein hamesha us side se shuru karein jis mein zyada cheezein hon, yahan right side (R.H.S.), kyunke usay simplify karna aasaan hai.

\({}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\) ko formula se likhein
\[{}^{n-1}P_{r-1} = \dfrac{(n-1)!}{[(n-1)-(r-1)]!}\]
\[= \dfrac{(n-1)!}{(n-r)!}\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(n\) ki jagah \(n - 1\) aur \(r\) ki jagah \(r - 1\) rakha. Bracket ko dhyan se kholein: \((n-1)-(r-1) = n - 1 - r + 1 = n - r\).
Dhyan dein: Minus ke baad bracket kholte waqt \(-(r-1)\) ko \(-r + 1\) likhna hai; sign ki ghalti yahan sab se zyada hoti hai.

\(n\) se multiply karein
\[\text{R.H.S.} = n \cdot \dfrac{(n-1)!}{(n-r)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n-1)!}{(n-r)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!}\]
Kyun: Factorial ki definition se \(n \cdot (n-1)! = n!\). Misaal: \(5 \cdot 4! = 5 \cdot 24 = 120 = 5!\).

Left side tak pahunchein
\[\dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!} = {}^{n}P_{r} = \text{L.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Yeh bilkul \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ka formula hai, to R.H.S. = L.H.S. ho gaya.

Ginti wali wajah (yeh sach kyun hai)
Socho \(n\) cheezon mein se \(r\) ko tarteeb se rakhna hai. Pehli jagah \(n\) tareeqon se bhar sakte hain. Ab \(r - 1\) jagahein bachi aur \(n - 1\) cheezein bachi, jinhein \({}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\) tareeqon se rakh sakte hain. Fundamental principle of counting se kul \(n \cdot {}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\).
Kyun: Dono tareeqe ek hi arrangements gin rahe hain, is liye jawab barabar aana hi tha. Yeh wajah samajh li to formula kabhi nahi bhoolega.

Numbers se tasdeeq
\(n = 5\), \(r = 3\):
\[{}^{5}P_{3} = 60\]
\[5 \cdot {}^{4}P_{2} = 5 \times 12 = 60 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi identity ko chhote numbers rakh kar check kar lena achhi aadat hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Prove from the first principle that: \({}^{n}P_{r} = {}^{n-1}P_{r} + r \cdot {}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi proof hai; is baar right side do permutations ka jama (sum) hai.
Humein dikhana hai ke yeh \({}^{n}P_{r}\) ke barabar hai (\(1 \le r \le n - 1\), taake \({}^{n-1}P_{r}\) ka matlab bane).
Plan: dono terms formula se likhenge, denominators barabar karke jama karenge, common factor nikaal kar simplify karenge; phir ginti wali wajah dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n\) alag cheezein, \(1 \le r \le n - 1\).
Saabit karna hai: \({}^{n}P_{r} = {}^{n-1}P_{r} + r \cdot {}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\).
Tareeqa: Har term ko \(\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\) wale formula se likhna, aur \((n-r)! = (n-r)(n-r-1)!\) laga kar dono fractions ka denominator ek jaisa karna.

Dono terms formula se likhein
\[{}^{n-1}P_{r} = \dfrac{(n-1)!}{(n-1-r)!}\]
\[{}^{n-1}P_{r-1} = \dfrac{(n-1)!}{(n-r)!}\]
Kyun: Pehli term mein sirf \(n\) ki jagah \(n - 1\) aaya. Doosri mein \((n-1)-(r-1) = n - r\), jaisa part (i) mein dekha.

Denominators barabar karein
\[\dfrac{(n-1)!}{(n-r-1)!} = \dfrac{(n-1)!\,(n-r)}{(n-r)!}\]
Kyun: \((n-r)! = (n-r)(n-r-1)!\) hota hai (jaise \(5! = 5 \cdot 4!\)). Is liye upar neeche \((n - r)\) se multiply kiya; value nahi badli, sirf shakal badli.
Dhyan dein: Fractions ko jama karne se pehle denominator ek jaisa karna zaroori hai, bilkul aam fractions ki tarah.

Dono terms jama karein
\[\text{R.H.S.} = \dfrac{(n-1)!\,(n-r)}{(n-r)!} + \dfrac{r\,(n-1)!}{(n-r)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{(n-1)!\,[(n-r) + r]}{(n-r)!}\]
Kyun: Ab denominator ek hai, to upar wale hisse jama kiye aur \((n-1)!\) ko common nikaal liya.

Simplify karein
\[= \dfrac{(n-1)! \cdot n}{(n-r)!}\]
\[= \dfrac{n!}{(n-r)!} = {}^{n}P_{r}\]
Kyun: Bracket mein \((n - r) + r = n\), \(r\) cancel ho gaya. Phir \(n \cdot (n-1)! = n!\). Yeh L.H.S. hai.

Ginti wali wajah (yeh sach kyun hai)
Ek khaas cheez chun lo, maslan \(A\). Har arrangement mein ya to \(A\) shamil nahi, ya shamil hai.
\(A\) ke baghair: baqi \(n - 1\) cheezon mein se \(r\) rakhni hain: \({}^{n-1}P_{r}\) tareeqe.
\(A\) ke saath: \(A\) \(r\) jagahon mein se kisi ek par baith sakta hai (\(r\) tareeqe), aur baqi \(r - 1\) jagahein \(n - 1\) cheezon se bharni hain: \({}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\) tareeqe; kul \(r \cdot {}^{n-1}P_{r-1}\).
Kyun: Dono cases mein koi arrangement do dafa nahi gina gaya aur koi chhoota bhi nahi, is liye inhein jama karte hain.
